players.product: gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), MV switchboards, vacuum circuit breakers and protection-relay panels

quarterly_data.signal: Customer Korea National Railway: supply contract signed 10-01-2026 to manufacture and install 72.5kV gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) for the substations of Honam High-Speed Railway Phase 2 (Gomakwon-Mokpo). Contract value KRW 4,350,000,000 excluding VAT, 11.40% of revenue (KRW 38,170,718,483, FY2025 consolidated); term 10-01-2026 to 10-31-2028; supply region Nam-gu, Jeonju-Gwangju Integrated Special City; no down payment or advance. The first PO-type goods purchase contract is KRW 5,000,000 (VAT included) for delivery by 12-31-2026, with further PO-type purchase contracts to be signed in stages as the project progresses. Amount and term may change with the contract's progress.
